questions.question: What woe opens Isaiah 33?
options: Woe to the rich who trust in their great wealth
Woe to the prophets who prophesy out of their hearts
Woe to the city that does not heed correction
Woe to the destroyer who has not been destroyed
questions.answer: Woe to the destroyer who has not been destroyed

questions.question: How is the LORD described in Isaiah 33?
options: Exalted on high, filling Zion with justice
Angry, pouring out wrath without mercy
Silent, leaving the people to their fate
Hidden, far removed from the affairs of men
questions.answer: Exalted on high, filling Zion with justice
